one_line: Visionary Indian physicist and space pioneer, architect of India’s early rocket and satellite programmes.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, lean build with a gentle but energetic posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, light brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed thin moustache, thoughtful wide eyes with soft dark brows, default expression calm and curious with a slight encouraging smile.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair, side-parted on the left, combed back in a smooth, conservative 1960s style, no visible headwear.
appearance.costume: A well-tailored mid-1960s Indian business outfit: crisp white long-sleeve shirt, medium-grey single-breasted wool suit jacket with narrow lapels, matching grey trousers with sharp crease, slim dark navy tie, simple black leather belt and polished black lace-up shoes; shirt collar slightly relaxed to feel approachable; occasionally visible simple silver wristwatch and a thin plain gold ring on his left hand but otherwise minimal jewellery.
appearance.signature: A rolled-up technical blueprint tube held in his left hand, with his right hand lightly resting on a small, cylindrical white rocket model inspired by the Nike-Apache/Rohini style, about forearm-length, with a black nose cone and simple black fin tips.

ref_desc: Vikram Sarabhai is a lean, early-40s man with an oval light-brown face, side-parted black hair, thin moustache, calm curious eyes, wearing a grey 1960s suit with white shirt and navy tie, holding a blueprint tube and a small white rocket model in a grey-white-navy-black palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Vikram Sarabhai as a dignified 1960s Indian space pioneer: a lean early-40s man with an oval light-brown face, sharp nose, thin moustache and calm, curious wide eyes under neatly combed, side-parted black hair. He wears a well-fitted medium-grey single-breasted suit jacket with narrow lapels over a crisp white long-sleeve shirt, a slim dark navy tie, matching grey trousers with a sharp crease, and polished black lace-up shoes, with a simple silver wristwatch and thin plain gold ring as his only jewellery. In his left hand he firmly holds a rolled-up technical blueprint tube, while his right hand rests lightly on a small, cylindrical white rocket model with a black nose cone and black fin tips, evoking early sounding rockets. Use a clean, grounded palette of medium grey, white, dark navy, black and light-brown skin tones, and present him front-facing, fully visible head-to-toe in a neutral stance that radiates quiet confidence and visionary focus.
